name: Web Therapy
description: Fiona Wallice is a therapist with limited patience for others' problems.

videos.title: Camila Bowner: Healing Touch
videos.overview: Fiona is eager to join Kip in his recovery, but discovers that his treatment with Camilla has progressed quickly, and alarmingly, beyond the usual talk and aversion therapy...

videos.title: Camila Bowner: Reverser Psychology
videos.overview: Fiona gives Camilla a hands-on demonstration of the effectiveness, or otherwise, of Camilla's therapeutic techniques when she arranges a meeting with Camilla's husband...

videos.title: An Old Flame (1)
videos.overview: Fiona is surprised when her new client turns out to be Richard, a fondly-remembered old flame.

videos.title: An Old Flame (2)
videos.overview: Fiona is more seductive than professional in counseling her former suitor about his new girlfriend.

videos.title: An Old Flame (3)
videos.overview: Fiona is flattered when Richard makes a surprisingly personal breakthrough.

videos.title: Sibling Ribaldry (1)
videos.overview: Fiona wants to terminate her dullest patient, Jerome—until he reveals a sensational and, for Fiona, potentially profitable family secret.

videos.title: Sibling Ribaldry (2)
videos.overview: Fiona meets with Jerome and his girlfriend, Hayley, to explore their "relationship"--and how it can best serve Fiona's practice.

videos.title: Sibling Ribaldry (3)
videos.overview: When Jerome's promotable backstory turns out to be false-- and thereby useless to Fiona-- the stressed-out therapist finally hits the roof.

videos.title: The Breakthrough (1)
videos.overview: Fiona accuses new client, Ted Mitchell, of being overly judgmental—until she discovers the real reason he sought her out for treatment.

videos.title: The Breakthrough (2)
videos.overview: Fiona practices her "groundbreaking technique" on Ted-- and the results are spectacular.

videos.title: The Breakthrough (3)
videos.overview: For Ted, it's a psychological breakthrough; for Fiona, it's one more opportunity to grow her brand.

videos.title: Psycho Analysis (1)
videos.overview: Fiona's new client, Claire, is a high-strung executive who doesn't have even three minutes to spare.

videos.title: Psycho Analysis (2)
videos.overview: Fiona's latest advice could cost Claire her job, and Fiona her health and well-being.

videos.title: Psycho Analysis (3)
videos.overview: Despite her best efforts, Fiona finds herself in another session with Claire, who she may be seeing for a very long time.

videos.title: Exposing The Truth (1)
videos.overview: Fiona meets Bren, a young career woman whose boyfriend, Justin, doesn't seem to appreciate all of her hard work.

videos.title: Exposing The Truth (2)
videos.overview: As if Bren's career wasn't fascinating enough, Justin reveals something about his parents that causes Fiona to want to clear her schedule.

videos.title: Exposing The Truth (3)
videos.overview: When Bren and Justin refuse to cooperate with Fiona, she makes a very enlightening discovery that reveals their true motives.

videos.title: Gossip Girl (1)
videos.overview: Fiona is put off by new client, Robin, a self-diagnosed exercise bulimic, until she shares a surprising fact about Fiona's husband.

videos.title: Gossip Girl (2)
videos.overview: Fiona, perturbed by Robin's disclosure, tries to rattle her with a barrage of psychological attacks–until Robin counters by revealing her true relationship with Fiona's husband.

videos.title: Gossip Girl (3)
videos.overview: Robin, heartbroken after her plans have backfired, drops an unexpected bombshell on Fiona.

videos.title: Office Politics (1)
videos.overview: Fiona continues to be bored by the relationship issues of her longtime client, Jerome, until she stumbles upon a way to use him in her marital battle.

videos.title: Office Politics (2)
videos.overview: Jerome, having taken Fiona's advice to heart, has landed himself in hot water with his company—and Fiona has to run for cover.

videos.title: Office Politics (3)
videos.overview: Jerome thanks Fiona for finding him a new position, but his complaints about his new employer leave her cold.

videos.title: Psychic Friends (1)
videos.overview: Serena Duvall is an internet psychic who needs help: she's lost her powers. Fiona doesn't believe in psychics -- but Serena has a surprise or two in store for her.

videos.title: Psychic Friends (2)
videos.overview: Serena claims Fiona has cured her. In return, Fiona sees an opportunity for national attention.

videos.title: Psychic Friends (3)
videos.overview: A tumultuous face-to-face meeting behind them, Serena and Fiona part ways -- but not before Serena issues one final prophecy...

videos.title: Kiss and Tell (1)
videos.overview: Fiona is shocked when her former employer and current investor, Robert Lachman, logs on to get her help with a rare compulsive disorder.

videos.title: Kiss and Tell (2)
videos.overview: Fiona agrees to help Robert, suddenly the country's most infamous swindler, but this drowning man almost submerges his rescuer...

videos.title: Kiss and Tell (3)
videos.overview: Fiona succeeds in benefiting from her association with Robert, but in a surprising way that leaves him furious and Fiona well on her way to being famous.

videos.title: Flying High (1)
videos.overview: Fiona finds the perfect client in Austen Clarke, the Scottish media mogul – and he's every bit as delighted with her.

videos.title: Flying High (2)
videos.overview: As luck would have it, Austen is perfectly situated to help Fiona with her latest venture, and she "reluctantly" agrees to let him put her on the map...

videos.title: Flying High (3)
videos.overview: Fiona is flying high with Austen – but an unexpected call from her husband could bring her right back to earth...

videos.title: Forget Me Not
videos.overview: Robin Griner returns to apologize to Fiona for trying to steal her husband... but while Fiona forgives, Robin won't let her forget.

videos.title: Staff Infection
videos.overview: Fiona tells her husband's campaign manager, Ben Tomlund, exactly how the campaign's going to be run—but he has a surprise for her.

videos.title: Why There Is No "Sister's Day"
videos.overview: Fiona turns to her sister Shevaun for some help—and gets a dose of her own medicine.

videos.title: Mommy Track
videos.overview: Fiona's assistant Jerome has a surprise for Fiona, courtesy of a girl with a dream and a bump.

videos.title: Fiona's Turn
videos.overview: Fiona's sister Shevaun proves that bad therapy--and resentment--are a family specialty.

videos.title: Mom Always Loved Me Best
videos.overview: Fiona completes her therapy with her sister Shevaun—and leaves her with the bill.

videos.title: Bringing Up Babies
videos.overview: Fiona discovers that babies are expensive, and Jerome and Tammy expect her to pay.

videos.title: Meet the Press
videos.overview: Fiona's first interview with a reporter, Kirsten Noble, proves to be stimulating in all the wrong ways.

videos.title: Maternity Leave
videos.overview: Fiona and the surrogate finally get to what's underneath it all.

videos.title: Dream Girl
videos.overview: Fiona's appearance on the website run by Kirsten Noble makes a big impression on the electorate.

videos.title: Mistress of the Web
videos.overview: Fiona has to educate digital journalist Kirsten Noble on how this thing called the Web REALLY works…

videos.title: That Old Pratt Magic
videos.overview: Fiona chats with old flame Richard Pratt on her husband's campaign and discovers he's still on fire.

videos.title: I Love You, Man
videos.overview: Fiona's irritation with her husband's campaign manager, Ben Tomlund, boils over when she begins to suspect the worst.

videos.title: Breaking Up is Hard to Do
videos.overview: Fiona does couples counseling with Richard and Robin, but things spin quickly out of control.

videos.title: Can You Get Up?
videos.overview: With the campaign in tatters, and Jerome threatening to quit, Fiona gets a boost when a broken Ben Tomlund comes back begging for help.

videos.title: Camilla Bowner: Aversion Therapy
videos.overview: Renowed sexual orientation therapist Camilla Bowner contacts Fiona about her new client Kip Wallice, who happens to be the most resistant man to the female form she's ever encountered -- and she's convinced Fiona is to blame!

videos.title: Camilla Bowner: Healing Touch
videos.overview: Fiona is eager to join Kip in his recovery, but discovers that his treatment with Camilla has progressed quickly -- and alarmingly -- beyond the usual talk and aversion therapy...

videos.title: Camilla Bowner: Reverse Psychology
videos.overview: Fiona gives Camilla a hands-on demonstration of the effectiveness -- or otherwise -- of Camilla's therapeutic techniques when she arranges a meeting with Camilla's husband...

videos.title: Morals to the Max
videos.overview: Fiona gets an earful from her publisher's chief of staff, Maxine DeMaine, who has a very low opinion of Fiona's writing skills – and her moral character.

videos.title: I Heart New York
videos.overview: Behind Fiona's back, Jerome flies up to New York to meet with Maxine to fix her book, but doesn't get the thanks he expects.

videos.title: Tokens of Affection
videos.overview: Baffled by the modest trickle of gifts from Austen, Fiona decides to take her affection—and book—elsewhere.

videos.title: Publishers Cleaning House
videos.overview: Fiona is outfoxed by the calculating Maxine, but the book is back where it belongs – and so is Austen…

videos.title: The Host Whisperer
videos.overview: Conan O'Brien contacts Fiona for help with unexpressed anger... but manages to express plenty when she fails to recognize him.

videos.title: Quid Pro Conan
videos.overview: Conan reaches across the country to help Fiona with a problem with her neighbor - and expects a favor in return.

videos.title: Guess Who's Coming to Late Night?
videos.overview: After his revenge plan backfires, Conan learns that when it comes to Fiona, feelings should be swallowed, not expressed.

videos.title: The Royal Treatment
videos.overview: When Fiona's new client, Gemma Pankhurst-Jones calls from Buckingham Palace, where she works as a "proxy" for the royal family, Fiona concludes this is therapy by proxy - and the new royal marriage is in trouble.

videos.title: Speed Bump
videos.overview: Fiona's conjugal advice is unsuccessful, and Gemma says she's running out of time -- she's pregnant, and her husband is bound to know he can't be the father! Can Fiona save the British empire?

videos.title: Heir Today Gone Tomorrow
videos.overview: The London tabloids are full of a royal scandal that mysteriously echoes Gemma's situation, and Gemma finally realizes that Fiona's therapy is all talk — mostly to the press...

videos.title: Hooray for Hollywood
videos.overview: Fiona thinks she’s been discovered by Hollywood when newly sober reality star Allegra Favreau calls to option Fiona’s memoir for a Lifetime television movie…

videos.title: That's How I Role
videos.overview: Allegra Favreau grills Fiona on some embarrassing details left out of her memoir, and Fiona offers up an acting critique of Allegra's past work, before they agree to work face-to-face in L.A.

videos.title: Come Fly with Me
videos.overview: Jerome surprises Fiona with an unwelcome travelling companion for her trip to Los Angeles...

videos.title: Acting Out
videos.overview: Fiona and Allegra conduct a post-mortem on the disastrous trip to Los Angeles. And Allegra, now a Hollywood pariah based on some unfortunate camera phone footage, prepares for a long stretch on the casting couch.

videos.title: Hands-On Therapy
videos.overview: Fiona's mother, Putsy Hodge, wants to be declared legally insane, and Fiona, once she finds out why, instantly agrees.

videos.title: Cell Phone
videos.overview: After her roommate's unfortunate death, Putsy Hodge prepares for life in the Big House, while Fiona begs her to lawyer up and take the Fifth.

videos.title: The Family Business
videos.overview: Fiona is pleased to discover that Putsy has been cleared of all charges -- but horrified when she discovers that Putsy has a new career -- and, worse, a new career advisor.

videos.title: Broadway Babies
videos.overview: Franny Marshall, who is writing the songs for Whistlin’, calls Fiona with a case of writer’s block.

videos.title: Encore, Encore!
videos.overview: Fiona calls Franny to share the good news that during a drunken night out on the town, Franny broke through her writer’s block.

videos.title: Eff Broadway
videos.overview: Franny’s new songs garner her major attention and propel her into the Pop world.

videos.title: Inspired by / Stolen From
videos.overview: Jerome tells Fiona the good news: Google wants to buy her mother’s copycat therapy business!

videos.title: Now You're Talking About My Mother
videos.overview: Jerome, no longer in Putsy’s good graces, calls Fiona to ask for his job back.

videos.title: Rubber Sheets
videos.overview: Fiona is infuriated to discover that Hayley has been using her NY Penthouse to entertain.

videos.title: Dixie. Pixie. Smiley Face.
videos.overview: Desperate for access to the campaign documents, Fiona calls Richard to see if he remembers the pass codes.

videos.title: It Might Have Been Ben Tomlund
videos.overview: Feigning interest in Robin’s “documentary” accomplishments, Fiona calls to get access to her tapes. Desperate for evidence that she’s been framed.

videos.title: Once a Blackmailer...
videos.overview: Fiona is horrified to learn that Robin once again has the upper hand – along with incriminating footage of Austen Clarke…

videos.title: One Big Russian Family
videos.overview: Fiona asks Richard to help her by destroying Robin’s damaging tapes.

videos.title: Just Say This Word
videos.overview: Fiona contacts Richard to give him a heads up that the FBI has been tipped off to his mob employers.

videos.title: Witless Protection
videos.overview: Richard tries to secretly contact Fiona to let her know that he and Robin will be going into Witness Protection.

videos.title: We're in Good with the NRA
videos.overview: Kip’s call with Fiona is interrupted by Ben, who has some unsettling campaign news.

videos.title: You Picked a Winner.
videos.overview: Fiona, concerned about how heated the investigation has become, calls Kip desperate for help with accessing his accounts.

videos.title: Game, Set Up, Match
videos.overview: A smug Fiona gets some satisfaction from Ben’s current predicament with the law.

videos.title: Rejuvenation
videos.overview: Fiona is shocked to find out that Austen plans to marry his baby mama Gina, to secure a legitimate heir.

videos.title: Get It Out of Me!!
videos.overview: A very pregnant Gina calls Fiona from Austen’s Jet to discuss wedding plans.

videos.title: Paternity Rites
videos.overview: Jerome contacts Gina with an unusual request having to do with her baby.

videos.title: The Archivist
videos.overview: Fiona introduces herself to Karen Sharpe, the hoarder who is obsessed with Kip, in order to strike a deal for his briefcase.

videos.title: You Know How I Love Puzzles
videos.overview: Fiona makes her way into Karen’s house to try and get her hands on Kip’s briefcase, which has the evidence she needs to clear herself.

videos.title: Extreme Makeover, Hoarder Edition
videos.overview: Karen calls Fiona very upset, having woken up to find herself and her home newly made-over.

videos.title: Lucky Charm
videos.overview: Fiona gets a call from a new patient Nick Jericho, whose wife says he has a gambling problem.

videos.title: Used Cards
videos.overview: Nick calls Fiona extremely frustrated that he has lost a lot of money to a crafty new online gambler.

videos.title: Deuces Ex Machina
videos.overview: Nick discovers that Fiona is the secret card shark who has been beating him online.

videos.title: Power Balls
videos.overview: New client Steve Olson reaches out to Fiona for help with his anxiety after winning the NY lottery.

videos.title: Divestment Opportunities
videos.overview: Steve questions Fiona’s motives after receiving a proposal to invest in Web Therapy.

videos.title: Swindle and the City
videos.overview: Fiona is shocked to learn that Steve isn’t who he claimed to be.

videos.title: Long-Distance Lovers
videos.overview: Young couple Blair and Augie reach out for advice from Fiona concerning their long-distance cyber relationship.

videos.title: Losing Followers
videos.overview: During a session with Blair and Augie, Fiona discovers that the couple is having relationship problems.

videos.title: Closer When We're Apart
videos.overview: Fiona is stunned to discover that Blair and Augie think they can solve their problems without her…

videos.title: Penetratress
videos.overview: Fiona becomes reacquainted with her former flame Chris Endicott, who has changed a lot since college…

videos.title: Hatching a Plan
videos.overview: Chris is desperate: does Fiona want to save a friend’s marriage?

videos.title: Spritzer Surprise
videos.overview: Fiona is upset that Chris suckered her into being taped by reality tv cameras at their dinner.

videos.title: Integrate Now
videos.overview: New client, Sylvie Frank, seeks Fiona’s advice concerning her office romance that has gone sour.

videos.title: You've Come a Long Way Baby
videos.overview: Fiona is stunned to learn her advice landed Sylvie a lucrative new job.

videos.title: From Before to After
videos.overview: Following a STYLEHAUL event, Fiona discovers she’s won a fashion makeover with Nina Garcia, creative director of Marie Claire magazine!

videos.title: Replacement Gifts
videos.overview: Caspar Lee calls to revoke Fiona’s auction-won makeover with Nina Garcia, and offer her anything else instead!

videos.title: Ladrona! Ladrona! Fiona!
videos.overview: Nina Garcia, against her better judgment, proceeds with Fiona’s makeover, but is surprised by the fallout of that decision.

videos.title: Internetainment
videos.overview: Caspar Lee calls with a very different proposal from last time, but Fiona’s desire to diagnose and impose her therapy gets in the way.

videos.title: Call Me Dad
videos.overview: Garreth Pink calls to complain about his new wife, Fiona’s mother!

videos.title: Marriage Sack
videos.overview: Having followed Fiona’s marriage counseling, Garreth calls back with some good and bad news.

videos.title: He Liked You Too Much
videos.overview: Putsy explains her recent marital woes to Fiona.

videos.title: Betsy Boss
videos.overview: Putsy prepares to “get in deep” with the governor during a Revolutionary War reenactment.

videos.title: We've Been Played
videos.overview: Hayley has returned from Bali with renewed spiritual purpose, and attempts to make amends with Fiona.

videos.title: Baby Bumps
videos.overview: Fiona and Hayley gang up on deceitful Jerome, but Fiona has an ace up her sleeve.

videos.title: Pump the Brakes
videos.overview: Putsy realizes the only way to win a Supreme Court appointment is to “manufacture a vacancy” on the Bench.

videos.title: Burdensome Gifts
videos.overview: Fiona is shocked to discover the NYC penthouse she received as a gift comes with very expensive strings.

videos.title: Potty Training
videos.overview: Jerome is taking full advantage of Fiona’s NYC penthouse, hopefully benefitting Fiona’s bottom line.

videos.title: Penthouse Problems
videos.overview: Fiona is on the hook for the penthouse expenses when Jerome admits it wasn’t as luxurious as he thought it’d be.

videos.title: Welcome Wagoner
videos.overview: Wealthy neighbor Grace Tiverton invites Fiona to join her women’s group, but what’s in it for Fiona?

videos.title: Neighbor/Nuisance
videos.overview: Following the poorly attended neighborhood game night, Fiona is suspicious of how well Grace Lknows the societal women she claims to know.

videos.title: Cunning Chameleon
videos.overview: Fiona’s attempt at an apology backfires when Grace reveals the changed circumstances in the ‘hood.

videos.title: Together But Apart
videos.overview: Fiona and Kip rekindle their relationship and admit that it’s better when they’re not together.

videos.title: Attachment Issues
videos.overview: Kip’s law clerk, April, goes above and beyond — maybe even too far — to satisfy his every need. Is Fiona in trouble?

videos.title: Out in the Open
videos.overview: April’s assistance is a dream come true for Fiona… well, except for her not-so-secret love for Fiona’s husband, Kip!

videos.title: All About April
videos.overview: April works her way towards being the new Mrs. Kip Wallice, and is Fiona even upset?

videos.title: Absolute Last Call
videos.overview: Fiona takes on a new client who is only interested in older women — much older!!

videos.title: Dropping Candy Bars
videos.overview: Jeb Masters questions his whole existence after meeting Fiona in person.

videos.title: Jeb Therapy
videos.overview: Jeb is relieved when he discovers Fiona is wiser and more wizened than he thought!

videos.title: Executor
videos.overview: Austen’s brother, Ewan Clarke, calls to clarify issues regarding the liquidation of Austen’s estate.

videos.title: Sell Out
videos.overview: Ewan is not responding well to his role as his brother’s executor. Can Fiona “help” him out?

videos.title: Net Therapy Redux
videos.overview: Ewan’s plan, to declare Austen insane, backfires without Fiona’s testimony, but there’s a silver lining that makes it all worthwhile.

videos.title: Looking at Other Things
videos.overview: Prudish new client Judith Frick asks Fiona for advice about a rocky relationship with her future son-in-law.

videos.title: Learning Experience
videos.overview: Judith Frick calls back, having had a much more intimate experience with her future son-in-law than she anticipated.

videos.title: Coital Consequences
videos.overview: Fiona’s plotting may have backfired, but she inadvertently solves all of Judith’s issues. Maybe she is a good therapist?

videos.title: State Secrets
videos.overview: A long-time admirer calls Fiona to come clean.

videos.title: Terror Threat
videos.overview: Admirer-turned-foe, Abel Jans, warns Fiona that she’s a terror threat – she only ruins people’s lives.

videos.title: Surprising Results
videos.overview: Fiona’s advice surprisingly hits home with Abel, so he’s turning over a new leaf, and Fiona’s off the hook!
